Veneer smile makeovers

This is the landing page the clinic does not yet have: one place that explains veneers properly, instead of a phone number and a booking link.

01

Veneers, including no-prep

Thin shells fitted to the front of the teeth to change shape, shade and alignment. No-prep veneers avoid removing healthy tooth structure where they are suitable — suitability is decided at consultation, not online.

Also: gum contouring to balance the gum line, and teeth whitening to finish or refresh a result.

Dental implants & complex rebuilds

For missing teeth and for mouths that need more than one fix at once: implants, crowns and rebuilds planned as a single sequence, with sleep dentistry (general anaesthetic) available for longer or more anxious cases.

Emergency dentistry is also available. No prices are published on the clinic’s site, and none are quoted here — ask in the booking form and the studio will advise.

Full service list: dental implants, veneers (including no-prep veneers), Invisalign, gum contouring, teeth whitening, sleep dentistry (general anaesthetic), complex rebuilds, emergency dentistry.

From first visit to final smile

1Consultation

Your smile, bite and goals — and an honest view of what will and will not work.

2Design

Veneer or implant plan shaped to your face, with whitening or gum contouring where it helps.

3Treatment

Carried out in stages for rebuilds; sleep dentistry available where appropriate.

4Aftercare

Checks and maintenance so veneers and implants last as they should.

Questions before you book

Do you publish prices?

No — the studio does not publish treatment prices, so this page quotes none. Use the booking form to ask about the treatment you have in mind.

What are no-prep veneers?

Veneers fitted with little or no removal of healthy tooth structure. Whether they suit your teeth is decided at consultation.

I am nervous about dental treatment. Can you help?

Yes — sleep dentistry (general anaesthetic) is listed among the studio’s services. Mention anxiety in your enquiry so it can be planned for.

What are your opening hours?

Monday 8:00am–8:00pm, Tuesday to Friday 8:00am–5:30pm, Saturdays by appointment.
